rule: Win grants highest actual defeated enemy level + 1; only the target authored skill tier is awarded. Defeats preserve growth and raise enemy level once.

cases: First Lv.1 enemy win grants Lv.2 and only tier 2 skills
Three defeats then Lv.5 win grants Lv.6, preserves old selection, does not grant skipped tiers
Group payout includes earlier defeated highest enemy, ignores cached next enemy level
Lv.27 enemy grants real Lv.28 without fictional skill IDs
Duplicate victory grants progression/reward only once
Three retained skills per category still require selection when overflowed

simulation.method: Production runtime and public-history AI on both sides. Enemy moves are committed first and never revealed to the hero policy. Defeats revive the settled run; victories grant rewards and use the ordinary shop.
limitations: AI benchmark, not human win rates.
Fixed newest-skill and healing-focused shop policy.
An unfinished battle at 80 turns is reported as stalled, never a victory.
